shepherd.speaker: A neighbor
shepherd.text: I left a note on the walk. Mrs. Hale isn't coming Sunday. She asked if someone would sit with her, not if you'd fill a pew.

builder.speaker: A neighbor
builder.text: The street looks like a church that means to grow. People notice a front that stays swept. That's how a week gets bigger.

skeptic.speaker: A neighbor
skeptic.text: You looked like you were still deciding, up there. That's allowed. I'm not asking you to sound sure.

plain.speaker: A neighbor
plain.text: Somebody left a bulletin on the walk. I picked it up. That's the news.
